definitions.explanation: used to ask about the number of times something has occurred or will occur

examples.japanese: {何回|なんかい}{言|い}ったら{分|わ}かるの？
examples.english: How many times do I have to tell you before you understand?

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}には{何回|なんかい}{行|い}きましたか。
examples.english: How many times have you been to Japan?

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{何回|なんかい}{見|み}ても{飽|あ}きない。
examples.english: No matter how many times I watch this movie, I never get tired of it.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{何|なん} (what, how many) + {回|かい} (times, counter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {何回|なんかい} ≈ {何度|なんど} (how many times)
- {何回|なんかい}も - many times
- {何回|なんかい}か - several times

COUNTER QUESTIONS PATTERN:
- {何人|なんにん} - how many people
- {何歳|なんさい} - how old
- {何枚|なんまい} - how many (flat objects)
- {何冊|なんさつ} - how many books
- {何杯|なんばい} - how many cups

USAGE:
- {何回|なんかい} tends to be used for concrete, countable repetitions
- {何度|なんど} can be more abstract or emotional
